mapper.select: SELECT * FROM module_instance WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM workflow_node_config WHERE workflow_definition_id=#{definition} AND node_id=#{node}
SELECT node_id FROM workflow_node_config WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM state_record WHERE module_instance_id=#{module} ORDER BY seq
SELECT * FROM workflow_task WHERE module_instance_id=#{module} AND status='OPEN' ORDER BY id

SELECT DISTINCT m.*,p.project_code,p.project_name,p.lifecycle_stage FROM module_instance m LEFT JOIN project_snapshot p ON p.project_id=m.project_id WHERE m.finished=FALSE AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM workflow_task t WHERE t.module_instance_id=m.id AND t.node_id=m.current_node_id AND t.status='OPEN') ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC
SELECT module_instance_id FROM expert_review_batch WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT m.*,p.project_code,p.project_name,p.lifecycle_stage, (SELECT t.candidate_role FROM workflow_task t WHERE t.module_instance_id=m.id AND t.node_id=m.current_node_id AND t.status='OPEN' ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 1) candidate_role, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM state_record s WHERE s.module_instance_id=m.id AND s.actor_user_id=#{userId} AND s.seq>1) operated FROM module_instance m LEFT JOIN project_snapshot p ON p.project_id=m.project_id
m.finished=FALSE AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM workflow_task t WHERE t.module_instance_id=m.id AND t.node_id=m.current_node_id AND t.status='OPEN') m.finished=TRUE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM state_record s WHERE s.module_instance_id=m.id AND s.actor_user_id=#{userId} AND s.seq>1) AND m.module_code=#{moduleType} AND (LOCATE(#{keyword},p.project_name)>0 OR LOCATE(#{keyword},p.project_code)>0 OR LOCATE(#{keyword},m.current_node_id)>0) AND (m.updated_at<#{beforeTime} OR (m.updated_at=#{beforeTime} AND m.id<#{beforeId}))
ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC,m.id DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT id,module_instance_id,workflow_node_id,round_no,status,created_by FROM expert_review_batch WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,module_instance_id,workflow_node_id,round_no,status,created_by FROM expert_review_batch WHERE module_instance_id=#{module} AND round_no=#{round}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM expert_review_assignment WHERE batch_id=#{id}

SELECT m.id FROM module_instance m WHERE m.finished=TRUE AND ((m.module_code='APPLICATION' AND m.current_state='APPLICATION_APPROVED') OR (m.module_code='CONTRACT' AND m.current_state='CONTRACT_APPROVED')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM module_instance n WHERE n.project_id=m.project_id AND n.module_code=CASE m.module_code WHEN 'APPLICATION' THEN 'CONTRACT' ELSE 'ACCEPTANCE' END) ORDER BY m.id LIMIT 50

SELECT t.id,m.project_id,m.module_code,t.round_no,t.node_id FROM workflow_task t JOIN module_instance m ON m.id=t.module_instance_id WHERE t.status='OPEN' AND t.candidate_role='PROJECT_LEADER' AND t.node_id=m.current_node_id AND m.finished=FALSE ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 200

SELECT b.id FROM expert_review_batch b JOIN module_instance m ON m.id=b.module_instance_id LEFT JOIN workflow_node_config n ON n.id=b.workflow_node_id WHERE b.access_ended_at IS NULL AND (m.finished=TRUE OR b.round_no<>m.current_round OR REPLACE(REPLACE(n.node_id,'ExpertAssignTask','ExpertReviewTask'),'ExpertSummaryTask','ExpertReviewTask')<>m.current_node_id) ORDER BY b.id LIMIT 100

SELECT b.id,m.project_id,m.module_code,b.round_no,REPLACE(REPLACE(n.node_id,'ExpertAssignTask','ExpertReviewTask'),'ExpertSummaryTask','ExpertReviewTask') task_node_id FROM expert_review_batch b JOIN module_instance m ON m.id=b.module_instance_id LEFT JOIN workflow_node_config n ON n.id=b.workflow_node_id WHERE b.id=#{id} AND b.access_ended_at IS NULL
SELECT DISTINCT expert_user_id FROM expert_review_assignment WHERE batch_id=#{id} ORDER BY expert_user_id
SELECT * FROM state_record WHERE module_instance_id=#{module} ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM module_instance WHERE project_id=#{project} AND module_code=#{type} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
SELECT limited_project FROM project_application WHERE project_id=#{project}
SELECT final_result FROM expert_review_batch WHERE module_instance_id=#{module} AND status='COMPLETED' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT payload_json FROM acceptance_form WHERE module_instance_id=#{module} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow_task SET assignee_user_id=#{owner} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='OPEN' AND candidate_role='PROJECT_LEADER'
UPDATE expert_review_batch SET access_ended_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND access_ended_at IS NULL
UPDATE workflow_task SET status='COMPLETED',completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE module_instance_id=#{module} AND status='OPEN'
